messages.content: Returns are eligible only if unopened, with a receipt, and within14 days of delivery. A shipping-delay waiver changes only the14-day limit, not the unopened/receipt requirements. Records:R1 unopened,receiptyes,day20,waiveryes;R2 opened,receiptyes,day10,waiveryes;R3 unopened,receiptno,day3,waiveryes;R4 unopened,receiptyes,day14,waiverno. Return JSON only:eligible(sortedIDs),denied(objectID->reason;opened takes priority over missing_receipt then late).
